title: PanaceaMed Body Exposure: next-gen graphics evidence and continuity ledger

inventories.note: Variants exist: do not interpret parent zero as zero variant geometry.

work_items.finding: AAA and topology verdict are inferred from request parameters; renderer flags and provenance are not measured artifact evidence.
work_items.next_action: Add evidence-backed evaluation preserving legacy API until consuming call sites are tested; replace random strings for new evidence records with real SHA-256 checksums.
work_items.acceptance: A missing/invalid mesh or texture artifact must never receive an AAA verdict; exact-head tests include negative controls.

work_items.finding: Source .blend and raw sources are explicitly not in git; a file name or registry alone is not an asset backup.
work_items.next_action: Register lawful sources, sha256, non-PHI immutable locations and verified restore tests, without executing Blender.
work_items.acceptance: Every release asset resolves to an immutable, verified object and licence record; unavailable items are flagged missing.

work_items.topic: Real PBR maps and material accuracy
work_items.finding: Procedural materials and 8K offline render profiles are documented, but evidence for comprehensive physically sourced 8K texture maps is not established.
work_items.next_action: Inventory existing legal texture files via GitHub-hosted artifacts, validate dimensions, channels, color spaces and content hashes; derive compressed web variants without claims of measured skin detail.
work_items.acceptance: Only real, independently readable texture artifacts receive a measured 8K/PBR label.

work_items.finding: QA records known open vessel ends and non-manifold areas. These must be classified with anatomy-specific expectations, not blindly repaired.
work_items.next_action: Extend GLB-native geometry, laterality, normals, winding and LOD deviation checks with source-specific tolerances.
work_items.acceptance: Every flagged mesh has measured error, decision and provenance; no geometry is silently replaced.

work_items.finding: Available manifest bodies are reference/atlas/individual source samples, not a consented personalized avatar of the viewer.
work_items.next_action: Implement a consented external appearance and anthropometry data contract in non-public storage, with source classes and uncertainty.
work_items.acceptance: Atlas and individual appearance cannot be conflated; no identifiable scan enters public git.

work_items.finding: No evidence of individual patient internal anatomy inferred from suitable personal imaging for this feature.
work_items.next_action: Create image registration and missing-data contracts with evidence tiers; never infer specific organs from face images.
work_items.acceptance: Every individual-specific internal claim has consented imaging, registration quality and authorized review, else explicitly unknown.

work_items.finding: Skeletal ROM and some motion clips exist; full muscle, fascia and skin deformation remains unresolved in documented work.
work_items.next_action: Deepen mesh/rig metadata and motion QA on existing exported artifacts without requiring Blender.
work_items.acceptance: Deformation tests record collisions, skeletal constraints, source provenance and real frame evidence.

work_items.finding: Existing viewer is budgeted for light web LOD; documented studio checks do not prove 8K real-time or photorealism on target devices.
work_items.next_action: Add reproducible browser/GPU-device frame-time, load-time, memory, KTX2 and mipmap evidence; keep adaptive quality and LOD.
work_items.acceptance: Performance is reported by device and exact commit; no hardware-agnostic 8K/60fps promise.

work_items.finding: Cinematic preview exists, but style references from games are not a validated comparison benchmark.
work_items.next_action: Define controlled source-linked view/lighting/textures screenshots and quantitative image/shape measures with human artistic review separate from clinical review.
work_items.acceptance: Every fidelity claim links to exact-head raw captures, checksums, methodology and reviewer limitations.

work_items.finding: Source-of-truth and gap ledger committed as version-controlled, additive documentation; no external binary backups are implied.
work_items.next_action: At each PR update links, observations and exact-head proof; keep decisions permanently in repository.
work_items.acceptance: A fresh agent can reconstruct the current priorities and claims from git without previous chat context.

update_rules: Never mark a work item verified solely from generated text or configuration labels.
A change in status requires a commit SHA, real evidence artifact, and exact-head checks.
Review source rights and privacy before publishing any binary assets.
Unknown quantitative data is null, never guessed.
Preserve all existing code and assets; GitHub-first means no Blender execution, not removal of history.
